---
title: "Age heaping simulation"
output: html_notebook
---

```{r setup}
library(here)
source(here("code", "helpers.R"))
set.seed(1)
```


## Parameters

```{r params}
a  <- 1e-4
b  <- 1/10

## Error model: every death age shifted ±4 years with equal probability
err_vals <- c(5, 0,  5)
err_prob <- c(.1, .8, .1)

age_full  <- 0:110
age_err   <- -4:114       ## extended range to hold shifted ages
plot_ages <- 60:95       ## stop at 95: below that, <400 deaths and estimates get noisy
```


## Approach 1: Analytic life table

```{r analytic}
## Gompertz cumulative hazard at integer boundaries
bounds <- 0:111
Hx     <- (a / b) * (exp(b * bounds) - 1)
lx     <- exp(-Hx)

## Deaths in each year-of-age interval
dx <- lx[-length(lx)] - lx[-1]
Dx <- round(1e7 * dx)                         ## 10M cohort: stable estimates at old ages

## Life table from unshifted ages
lx_an <- rev(cumsum(rev(Dx)))
qx_an <- setNames(Dx / lx_an, age_full)

## Apply errors to every individual
X        <- rep(age_full, Dx)
X_err_an <- X + sample(err_vals, length(X), prob = err_prob, replace = TRUE)

## Life table from shifted ages (over extended range so no deaths fall outside)
Dx_an_e  <- as.integer(table(factor(X_err_an, levels = age_err)))
lx_an_e  <- rev(cumsum(rev(Dx_an_e)))
qx_an_e  <- setNames(Dx_an_e / lx_an_e, age_err)
```


## Approach 2: Simulation via gompertztrunc_simu

```{r simulate}
N <- 2e7

ages_sim <- gompertztrunc_simu(
  n       = N,
  a0      = a,
  b       = b,
  formula = death_age ~ sex,
  coefs   = c(sex = 0),
  dummy   = TRUE
) %>%
  mutate(age = as.integer(floor(death_age))) %>%
  pull(age)

## Apply the same errors
ages_sim_e <- ages_sim + sample(err_vals, N, prob = err_prob, replace = TRUE)

## Scale counts to match the 10M analytic cohort
scale    <- 1e7 / N
Dx_sim_e <- round(as.integer(table(factor(ages_sim_e, levels = age_err))) * scale)
lx_sim_e <- rev(cumsum(rev(Dx_sim_e)))
qx_sim_e <- setNames(Dx_sim_e / lx_sim_e, age_err)
```


## Plot: both curves on top of each other

```{r plot, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4.5}
s <- as.character(plot_ages)

tibble(
  age         = plot_ages,
  Analytic    = as.numeric(qx_an_e[s]),
  Simulation  = as.numeric(qx_sim_e[s])
) %>%
  pivot_longer(-age, names_to = "method", values_to = "qx") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = age, y = qx, color = method, linetype = method)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("steelblue", "#D55E00")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("solid", "dashed")) +
  cowplot::theme_cowplot() +
  labs(
    x = "Age", y = "q(x)  [log scale]",
    color = NULL, linetype = NULL,
    title    = "Analytic vs. simulation: identical Gompertz + ±4 year errors",
    subtitle = sprintf("Gompertz a = %.0e, b = %.1f. Every death shifted ±4 yrs (prob 0.5 each).", a, b)
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9))
```


## Alignment check

```{r alignment, fig.width = 4.5, fig.height = 4.5}
tibble(
  age      = plot_ages,
  analytic = as.numeric(qx_an_e[s]),
  sim      = as.numeric(qx_sim_e[s])
) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = analytic, y = sim)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  cowplot::theme_cowplot() +
  labs(x = "qx — analytic", y = "qx — simulation", title = "Alignment check")
```


## Three-curve plot: no error, with error (analytic), with error (sim)

```{r three-curves, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4.5}
## Life table from sim ages with NO error applied
Dx_sim_clean <- round(as.integer(table(factor(ages_sim, levels = age_full))) * scale)
lx_sim_clean <- rev(cumsum(rev(Dx_sim_clean)))
qx_sim_clean <- setNames(Dx_sim_clean / lx_sim_clean, age_full)

tibble(
  age                        = plot_ages,
  `No error (sim)`           = as.numeric(qx_sim_clean[as.character(plot_ages)]),
  `With error (analytic)`    = as.numeric(qx_an_e[s]),
  `With error (sim)`         = as.numeric(qx_sim_e[s])
) %>%
  pivot_longer(-age, names_to = "curve", values_to = "qx") %>%
  mutate(curve = factor(curve, levels = c(
    "No error (sim)", "With error (analytic)", "With error (sim)"
  ))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = age, y = qx, color = curve, linetype = curve)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("steelblue", "black", "#D55E00")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("solid", "solid", "dashed")) +
  cowplot::theme_cowplot() +
  labs(
    x        = "Age",
    y        = "q(x)  [log scale]",
    color    = NULL,
    linetype = NULL,
    title    = "Effect of ±4 year age errors on mortality curve",
    subtitle = sprintf(
      "Gompertz a = %.0e, b = %.1f. Errors: ±4 yrs with prob 0.5 each.",
      a, b
    )
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9))
```


## Rounding to nearest 0 or 5 (digit heaping on death age)

```{r rounding, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4.5}
## Round a fraction p of ages to the nearest multiple of 5
p_heap <- 0.6   ## 50% of ages heaped — exaggerated to make the effect visible
ages_sim_rounded <- ifelse(
  runif(N) < p_heap,
  round(ages_sim / 5) * 5L,
  ages_sim
)

Dx_sim_rounded <- round(as.integer(table(factor(ages_sim_rounded, levels = age_full))) * scale)
lx_sim_rounded <- rev(cumsum(rev(Dx_sim_rounded)))
qx_sim_rounded <- setNames(Dx_sim_rounded / lx_sim_rounded, age_full)

s_full <- as.character(plot_ages)

plot_df <- tibble(
  age                 = plot_ages,
  `No heaping`        = as.numeric(qx_sim_clean[s_full]),
  `Heaped (p = 0.4)` = as.numeric(qx_sim_rounded[s_full])
) %>%
  pivot_longer(-age, names_to = "curve", values_to = "qx")

## 5-year rolling average of the heaped curve
rolling_avg <- plot_df %>%
  filter(curve == "Heaped (p = 0.4)") %>%
  arrange(age) %>%
  mutate(
    qx_roll = zoo::rollmean(qx, k = 5, fill = NA, align = "center"),
    curve   = "Heaped — 5yr rolling avg"
  ) %>%
  select(age, curve, qx = qx_roll)

bind_rows(plot_df, rolling_avg) %>%
  mutate(curve = factor(curve, levels = c(
    "No heaping", "Heaped (p = 0.4)", "Heaped — 5yr rolling avg"
  ))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = age, y = qx, color = curve, linetype = curve)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("steelblue", "#D55E00", "#D55E00")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("solid", "solid", "dashed")) +
  cowplot::theme_cowplot() +
  labs(
    x        = "Age",
    y        = "q(x)",
    color    = NULL,
    linetype = NULL
    ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9))
```
